scope.purpose_zh: 为一个机械回收外围试点明确既有结果字段、计划新增分项账及只读汇总数据流。
scope.existing_reference_status: W01/N01已结案；本合同不重新验收、不改写其评分或原始证据。
scope.cross_environment_pairing: forbidden: W01 and N01 are different environments and are not a causal pair
scope.candidate_feasibility_authority: The actual candidate validator and its audited operation/input/terminal contracts; never this field reader.

native_success.meaning: Existing ScenarioValidationResult success; assigned from production_success. It is not a yield-quality score.

warnings.current_rule: The v1.1 candidate validator fails on any unreviewed warning.

primary_outcome_contract.positive_closed_outcome: Use the exact reported quantity when the actual candidate validator confirms execution_complete=true, production_success=true, no failures, and a finite positive warehouse quantity.
primary_outcome_contract.zero_closed_outcome: Use exact zero when the actual validator reports execution_complete=true, production_success=false, status=zero_yield_completed, no failures, and a finite zero warehouse quantity. Do not change production_success to true.
primary_outcome_contract.failed_or_incomplete_outcome: Retain the raw reported warehouse quantity, flags, status and failures. Set primary_outcome=null. Do not convert the quantity to zero or present it as validated safe delivery.
primary_outcome_contract.missing_or_invalid_fields: Retain the source evaluation and report adapter issues; do not use a legacy fallback or fill missing values with zero.
primary_outcome_contract.normalization: none: do not clip or normalize by a reference yield; the reference is not an optimum
primary_outcome_contract.validator_boundary: Basic field consistency is not a new feasibility validator. A future H01 validator must audit the new mechanical process and loss ledger.

fields.meaning: Actual full-field recovered dry matter from the native recovery ledger before display rounding; not mature TWSO times an assumed constant recovery rate.
Actual machine-attributed dry matter loss under the trial's explicitly defined loss decomposition. Other field losses must not be assigned to this category.

An immutable quality snapshot taken after immediate legality checks and before harvest time advances. The exact same q_pass is supplied to HarvestAction and FarmActionRecord when settlement is registered; a later repair cannot change this batch.

loss_accounting_requirements: The same native harvest loss is applied once, not also subtracted by the summary adapter.
Record the applicable loss components and any clipping so their attribution is explicit.
Keep mature dry matter, recovered dry matter and actual standard-moisture warehouse mass separate.
Check the mechanical trial's actual loss and mass ledger in the candidate validator; the reader does not reconstruct a physical ledger.

handoff_reader.writes: one new JSON artifact; never overwrites an existing file
does_not: add an existing FAIRY CLI command

planned_production_summary.not_an_existing_command: There is no summarize action in the frozen run_maize_basic_reference.py; its actions are preflight and run.
data_flow: Accepted public actions update the native recovery process and an immutable batch ledger.
The actual H01 candidate validator evaluates terminal feasibility and the new loss ledger.
The run stores evaluation.json plus batch and operation evidence without changing old runs.
A future read-only production summary reads those outputs, preserves raw flags and quantities, and displays the declared primary outcome and process decomposition.
Any paired difference is computed only for explicitly matched H01 configurations, initial states and external events; never from the existing W01 and N01 environments.

included_field_wiring_example.source_identity: Existing frozen N01 v1.1 positive-reference evaluation
included_field_wiring_example.evidence_label_zh: 历史字段接线校验；不是H01结果，不是新增全季验收，不是配对比较。
